reading.action: Light the brazier with his ember; place the fire-purged rivet into the flame; watch with essence-sense to read whether ember essence is increasing from the flame.
reading.ignition: Lighting the dry kindling with projected ember = trivial for Journeyman Ember Channel; auto-success, Focus -5. Fire caught, coal bed formed, damp driftwood beginning to take. First real sustained flame in the Tower.
reading.result: CLEAN READ (margin 26). Full, truthful discovery. (1) FLAME IS NOT A SOURCE: a mundane wood fire yields only the faintest, diffuse haze of true ember essence — real but vanishingly thin, dispersing as fast as it rises; NOT drawable, NOT harvestable, can't grow his affinity. Direct answer to his question 'is ember essence increasing from the flame?' = NO (no farm; flame essence is faint + static). (2) FIRE-PURGED RIVET IS CHARGING: the heat-affinity seed in the flame DRINKS the diffuse heat-essence and concentrates it into its same-element core, thickening over time — not creating essence, gathering it. A heat-seed becoming a slow heat-essence battery. (3) PRINCIPLE GRASPED: raw fire disperses essence; a same-element seed concentrates it. COST: Focus 80 -> 75 (-5 ignition). NO affinity tick (sensing, not absorbing; lighting fire is a trivial anti-farm-capped ember use) -> Ember Manipulation counter stays 1. NO skill tick (trivial application). Rivet left charging in the flame (no assumed follow-up). NO Tower reset.
